## ✅ Quality & Pre-Flight Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the project's TypeScript & ESLint guidelines.
- [ ] I have run `npx tsc --noEmit` locally with **0 errors**.
- [ ] I have run `npm test` and all unit/component tests pass.
- [ ] I have verified responsiveness across Mobile (375px), Tablet (768px), and Desktop (1440px+).

- [ ] All new components use semantic HTML5 elements where applicable.
